items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: Pierron's orchestra was a society band here. They were very good, I heard them. And then after we organized a large band, we would meet them playing the different balls... And Pierron's band and our band would be the bands of the night.

ctx.x: Did you hear much of Pierron's orchestra when you were young?

Yes, when I faced young, the orchestra, Pierron's orchestra was a society band here. They were very good, I heard them. And then after we organized a large band, we would meet them playing the different balls, because at that time we were playing the carnival balls. And Pierron's band and our band would be the bands of the night. And at the country club we would meet them quite often.
So they had quite a nice band?
